title: Fountain of Life, and God of Love
description: Fountain of Life, and God of Love in Tonic Solfa to ST. PETER, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 396, “Seed-Time and Harvest Shall Not Cease”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. PETER; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Foun-tain of life, and God of love! How rich Thy boun-ties are! The roll-ing sea-sons, as they move, Pro-claim Thy con-stant care.

lines: Fountain of life, and God of love!
The rolling seasons, as they move,
When in the bosom of the earth
Thy goodness marked its secret birth,
The spring's sweet influence, Lord, was Thine,
Thou gav'st the ripening suns to shine,
The bounteous harvest crowns the year,
With thankful hearts we trace Thy way
Thou, by whose love, nor night nor day,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1848.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST. PETER by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
